title: Benchmark: can the loop with Hobbhahn's pre-T user model recover his later eval-awareness discoveries?
body: Ethan (2026-11-14): make 'recover his discoveries' one of our own benchmarks. Sketch: cutoff T before a known finding (e.g. Needham et al. 2025: models detect evals from transcripts, more so in agentic ones). Build the user model from pre-T docs only, run R0 vs R1-S, and score whether proposals/confirmed findings match his post-T findings (blind judge rubric written before any run). Main risk: the base model has read the papers, so check contamination with track_eval m0_named and a no-taste arm. Distinct from E2, which only predicts binary choices.
